messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: SLO breach detected for /v1/stream (us-west2). p95=310ms (SLO=250ms), p99=1680ms (SLO=1000ms). Error rate nominal. High tail latency and streaming stalls observed.

shea: paging eng-oncall (oncall: @rohit) — p99 spike, some streaming requests timing out at client side. any quick mitigations? :hand: 1732100000

rohit: on it. looking at dashboards now. which tenant/route?

incident-bot: Top affected route: /v1/stream (model: gpt-open-1-q4). Tenant-IDs: 9821, 4417 (multi-tenant traffic). Continuous-batcher latency heatmap attached in alert. 1732100001

rohit: TL;DR from logs: a few batches with mixed seqLens overwhelming KV cache; big batches (size=60+) include several long sequences => kv lookup stalls + paging into host memory. streaming sessions get held while batch completes.

rohit: quick repro snippet from runner logs:
```
[2024-11-02T16:12:23Z] batch_id=98765 size=62 seqlens=[6,8,512,14,256,10,...] tail_wait=1250ms kernel_wait=1100ms kv_evictions=34
[2024-11-02T16:12:24Z] stream_write_timeout tenant=9821 request_id=abc123 duration=1205ms
```

deven: can we patch scheduler to prefer grouping similar seqLens? or reduce max_batch_size for streaming routes as a hotfix?

rohit: short-term mitigations I'd recommend in order:
1) set feature flag disable_cont_batch_for_route=/v1/stream (instant, flips batching to per-request).
2) reduce max_batch_size from 64 -> 24 for streaming workloads.
3) enable preemptive-shed for long sequences (drop into fallback path).
Apply 1 and 2 now as immediate. 1732100012

maria: customer-impact check: CS reports 2 customers seeing elevated client timeouts and at least one outage ticket opened. will notify them once we have mitigation plan.

rohit: applying flag now (canary to 2 hosts in us-west2), command:
```bash
curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/flags -d '{"route":"/v1/stream","disable_cont_batch":true,"canary_hosts":["usw2-a-21","usw2-a-22"]}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
Starting rollout.

ops-bot: Runbook: applied flag disable_cont_batch_for_route=/v1/stream to hosts [usw2-a-21, usw2-a-22]. Observing. 1732100020

rohit: also pushing scheduler config: `max_batch_size=24` and `batch_similarity_weight=0.7` for the route. will monitor p95/p99.

incident-bot: Config change submitted: change_id=cc-7732 (max_batch_size=24 for /v1/stream). Canary started. 1732100025

shea: lives updates: after flag canary, initial canary hosts show p99 drop from 1680ms -> 430ms. good sign. please expand if stable.

maria: CS: informing customers A & B that we're applying mitigation, might see transient throttling. prep message: "We're rolling a mitigation to reduce streaming tail latency; you may see a brief change in throughput while this rolls out." Want me to send?

customer-success: yes please, include ETA 30m and mention follow-up postmortem.

rohit: expanding rollout to 50% hosts now. watch list: p99, qps, stream_stalls metric.

ops-bot: Rollout to 50% successful. monitoring shows p95 back within SLO and p99 trending down. 1732100029

deven: note: disabling cont-batching increases token-cost slightly for those requests. Track cost delta in optimizer dashboard.

rohit: agreed. tradeoff fine for customer experience. Postmitigation plan: re-enable cont-batching with improved scheduling heuristics (seqlen bucketing) and KV-eviction tuning. moving to P2 incident.

maria: CS update sent. two customers acknowledged. one raised concern about throughput drop; we told them it's temporary.

shea: escalate to infra-research for medium term: can we add a per-tenant max_batch cap or seqlen-aware packer? assign @deven and @rohit.

rohit: assigning follow-ups:
- short (today): telemetry alert tweak to detect mixed-seqlen batches (owner: rohit)
- medium (week): seqlen-aware packer + per-route batch caps (owner: deven)
- long (postmortem): KV cache policy improvement and eviction metrics (owner: infra-research)

rohit: creating a quick incident doc and starting SLO blameless postmortem. include logs snippet and canary graphs.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-1102-07, severity=P2. Pagerduty notification sent to infra-research and eng-sre. 1732100055

maria: I'll coordinate customer follow-ups and timelines, also ask for an executive note if impact widens.

shea: final status for thread: mitigations in place, p99 improved, monitoring for regressions for 1h, follow-ups assigned. will hand off to oncall rotation for ongoing tracking. thanks team. :heart: 1732100360

rohit: leaving notes for oncall: if p99 creeps >900ms revert rollout and isolate tenant 9821 to dedicated pool `dedicated-stream-small`. commands to revert in runbook.

maria: adding incident to incident log and scheduling postmortem sync tomorrow 10:00 PT.

customer-success: closing loop with customers and flagging for prioritized support.
